abstract: Audits a Gradle project against the official Gradle best practices, produces a prioritized findings report, and proposes code changes to bring the build into compliance. The best-practices catalog is fetched live from docs.gradle.org on every run — this skill ships no embedded list, so it always reflects the latest published documentation. Operates in audit mode (report and stop) or apply mode (proceed straight to fixes). Discovers settings, build scripts, properties, wrapper config, version catalog, and Java/Kotlin/Groovy sources under buildSrc/ and build-logic/. For each best practice it derives a detection approach (deterministic or heuristic) from the published description, applies it to the project's files, and links each finding to the specific best practice in the Gradle User Manual.
